correctness.rationale: For nonempty S in a tournament, internal arcs give |F_i(S) intersect S|>=|S|-1. For |S|>=2, the forward/backward neighbor image is terminal in its own direction: each omitted vertex points to/receives from a survivor. When direction switches, all vertices outside the previous terminal set and all but at most one inside are reached, giving n-1. Singleton terminal sets are necessarily global sink/source; the same-direction step that would empty them violates the run condition. Full induction on arbitrary length uses terminality and n-r, with transitive tournament attaining all r<n. The clique lower language follows from each orientation containing an oriented K_n; a proper n-coloring gives an increasing-color orientation ruling out n-runs. The run GF and Myhill–Nerode suffix distinguishability give exactly 2n complete DFA states. Independently exhaustively explored the endpoint powerset/run product for ALL 1,098 labeled tournaments with n=2..5, including arbitrarily long legal words per fixed n; finite tests do not establish general n.

originality.rationale: The initiating 2026 Pujol paper defines all-vertices-initial graph automata and remanent orientation languages, and already connects chromatic number to all-forward walks. The K_n run-language statement alone is an elementary consequence of the setup and is not claimed as new. The substantial survivor is a sharp n-r surviving-endpoint inequality uniform over ALL tournaments and direction changes, with extension to every graph having omega=chi and exact DFA enumeration. Pujol full text was not available in this run; its abstract plus source self-review description do not justify claiming complete noncoverage, so a targeted primary-text priority risk remains.

final_claim: For every loopless tournament T on n>=2 with every vertex initially reachable and accepting, if binary forward/reverse word w avoids runs of n equal letters and its final run has length r, then the ending subset has size at least n-r, sharply attained by a transitive tournament. For any graph with omega(G)=chi(G)=n the orientation-intersection language is precisely run-avoiding words, with GF (1-z^n)/(1-2z+z^n) and minimal complete DFA 2n states.
